column1: # TITLE:  Week 10 injury report, re-read on 2026-11-18 - the two games read to completion
# SOURCE: https://www.nfl.com/injuries/ (the league's current injury page; it still prints Week 10)
# SCOPE:  4 of the 14 Week 10 club tables were transcribed in this read - WAS, NYG (Thursday game)
#         and NE, DET (Sunday 9:30 AM game). The read was cut inside the Chiefs table at chunk 1, so
#         KC and every later club is NOT re-read here and is not claimed by this file. A row count in
#         this pack therefore never describes the whole report; the whole-report count comes from the
#         automated capture store (see the capture series panel).
# RULE:   Cells are compared with data/injuries_2026_week10.csv by tools/verify_2026_11_18.py. A cell
#         that disagrees is published as a mismatch, never silently re-pointed at either side.
# DISPLAY: "Chig Okonkwo" and "Carlton Davis III" are the display names the page prints in the link
#         text; the player URL slugs say chigoziem-okonkwo and carlton-davis. Both are kept: the
#         display name is what a reader sees, the slug is what a join can use.
